methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched directly via WebFetch and re-verified on 2026-06-18/18 for Semrush AI PR Toolkit (semrush.com/kb/1575-pricing-and-plans), Prezly (prezly.com/pricing), Mynewsdesk (mynewsdesk.com/en/plans/), JustReachOut (justreachout.io/pricing), Presspage (presspage.com/pr-software-plans), Muck Rack (muckrack.com/pricing), Meltwater (meltwater.com/en/pricing), and Roxhill (roxhillmedia.com/pricing). Notified's direct pricing page was unreachable; pricing model confirmed quote-only via Capterra and corroborating review sites. WebSearch corroborated Prowly->Semrush transition, quote-only models, and compliance. Self-serve published rates shown; EUR-denominated plans (Prezly, Mynewsdesk, Presspage) left in EUR as displayed — monthlyUsd left null for EUR plans rather than guessing a converted figure. Presspage ISO certification corrected to ISO 27001:2013 (per official KB), not 27001:2022. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Semrush AI PR Toolkit (formerly Prowly)
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched semrush.com/kb/1575-pricing-and-plans on 2026-06-18; Base $149/mo and Pro $279/mo confirmed exact. Prowly was acquired by Semrush and rebranded as the Semrush AI PR Toolkit; legacy standalone Prowly plans are no longer sold to new customers.

plans.name: Base
plans.notes: AI-cited media database access, email outreach with tracking, press release creation, newsroom hosting, AI writing assistance; usage limits apply on email sends and contact exports. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: All Base features plus automated follow-ups, advanced analytics/reporting, social media monitoring, weekly LLM-cited media updates; higher email/contact limits. 7-day free trial.

limits: Email send limits per plan (exact numbers in-app)
keyFeatures: AI-cited media database showing outlets referenced by LLMs
AI-assisted press release writing and newsroom hosting
enrichment.provenance: Base $149/mo and Pro $279/mo confirmed exact via Semrush official KB article (re-verified). 7-day trial on either plan; no forever-free tier. Transition from Prowly brand confirmed.

vendors.name: Prezly
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched prezly.com/pricing on 2026-06-18; Essential €100/mo and Standard €250/mo (both billed annually, 20% off vs monthly) confirmed; Enterprise is custom. Prices published in EUR only; monthlyUsd left null rather than converting.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: €100/month billed annually (20% discount vs monthly); ~€125/month if billed monthly. 1 user, 1 site max, up to 5,000 contacts, unlimited stories and campaigns, full analytics, Prezly-branded newsroom, single language. 14-day free trial, no credit card.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: €250/month billed annually (20% discount vs monthly); ~€313/month if billed monthly. 2 users, 1 site, up to 10,000 contacts, white-label sites, custom domain, localization with auto-translations. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing; contact sales. All Standard features plus custom user/site limits, premium onboarding, 24/7 support with live training, custom site layouts, SSO, 99% uptime SLA.

enrichment.provenance: Pricing re-fetched from prezly.com/pricing. EUR-denominated; monthlyUsd left null (no official USD figure). 14-day free trial; no forever-free tier.

Scandinavian market heritage with global reach

plans.name: Advanced Outreach
plans.notes: Monthly: $247/mo. Annual: $165/mo (billed annually, 33% discount). 300 email sends/month, 2 team members, 5 brands, AI pitch engine, journalist search, verified emails, weekly briefing.

plans.name: Ultimate Outreach
plans.notes: Monthly: $497/mo. Annual: $331/mo (billed annually, 33% discount). 1,000 email sends/month, 5 team members, 10 brands, AI pitch engine, journalist search, verified emails, narrative sessions.
